plugins.name: ai-lawyer
plugins.description: AI Team in-house legal research assistant for founders: verifies every law against official sources before using it, reviews contracts, keeps an append-only legal history in a private workspace, watches for legal changes, and improves itself from what it learns. Jurisdiction packs (Armenia included). Not a licensed lawyer.
